hypotheses.reasoning: Gateway 503s (#251, #255, #260 etc.) are downstream symptoms: notification-svc returns 503 because its render call to template-svc fails. The origin appears at 13:21:03 when notification-svc v3.13.0 (build 1816aca) began rolling out with config revision 645 (#236). At 13:21:28 config reloaded with TEMPLATE_SVC_URL=http://template-svc.internal:8081 changed (#243). From about 13:21:59 onward every TemplateClient.render from notification-svc fails with connect ECONNREFUSED 10.17.189.215:8081 (#248, #256, #258, #271). Template-svc itself logs no errors and keeps running (GC lines through 13:32), and it served successful /render calls up to 13:21:10 (#238), so the refusals are specific to notification-svc's new endpoint resolution. Caveat: the logged URL matches template-svc's port, so the exact wrong value (host or IP) is not visible in the logs; the change coincides with the config reload and rollout. Not a template-svc resource problem (no OOM or error lines, GC normal); not a notif-db issue (only a slow audit_log seq scan at #227, unrelated and not on the failing path).

Alternative reading: the v3.13.0 rollout itself (build 1816aca) introduced a broken template-client connection behavior, and the config reload is just concurrent with it. Timing fits: refusals start within a minute of the rollout and config reload. Rolling back notification-svc to the prior version would confirm or rule this out.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc to the pre-v3.13.0 build and/or revert config revision 645 so TEMPLATE_SVC_URL is restored to the previously working endpoint. Then verify notification-svc can reach template-svc (connect succeeds to template-svc.internal:8081) and that gateway POST /v1/notify success recovers. Compare the old and new TEMPLATE_SVC_URL values from config revision 644 vs 645, since the logs don't show the previous value. Follow up on the slow audit_log seq scan on notif-db (#227) separately as a non-blocking issue.
